A tiny dull-violet flower and teal flask emblem appears as a small embroidered house badge at the chest. She holds ONE small stoppered turquoise glass fragrance bottle near waist height and a closed slim account book under the other arm. Few props, no weapons, no armour, no crown or invented official insignia. Teal and violet are subdued accents from the actual emblem, not bright magical glow.
